title: The Shallow End
summaryZh: 四十一歲的伊萬報名了成人游泳課。第一堂課有六個大人站在淺水區,還有一位比他年輕十六歲的教練。

sentences.text: Ivan was forty-one years old and he could not swim.
sentences.zh: 伊萬四十一歲,不會游泳。

sentences.text: He had walked past the town pool twice a week for eleven years without going in.
sentences.zh: 十一年來,他一週兩次經過鎮上的游泳池,從來沒進去過。

sentences.text: The class was on Tuesday evenings and it was called Adult Beginners.
sentences.zh: 那堂課在星期二晚上,名字叫「成人初級班」。

sentences.text: He filled in the form online so that he would not have to say it out loud.
sentences.zh: 他在網路上填了表格,這樣就不必開口講出來。

sentences.text: On the first evening there were six of them standing in the shallow end.
sentences.zh: 第一堂課那天晚上,他們六個人站在淺水區。

sentences.text: The water came up to his chest and it was colder than he had expected.
sentences.zh: 水到他胸口,比他想像中冷。

sentences.text: Nobody looked at anybody else, which told him everything about the group.
sentences.zh: 沒有人看別人,這件事就說明了這一群人的一切。

sentences.text: Their teacher was a young woman called Petra who was twenty-five.
sentences.zh: 教練是一位二十五歲的年輕女子,叫佩特拉。

sentences.text: Ivan did the arithmetic without meaning to: she was sixteen years younger than him.
sentences.zh: 伊萬不自覺算了一下:她比他小十六歲。

sentences.text: Petra did not begin with arms or legs or any kind of stroke.
sentences.zh: 佩特拉一開始沒教手、沒教腳,也沒教任何一種泳式。

sentences.text: She asked them to put their faces in the water and blow out slowly.
sentences.zh: 她要他們把臉放進水裡,慢慢把氣吐出來。

sentences.text: That was the whole first lesson, and it took forty minutes.
sentences.zh: 整堂課就只有這件事,做了四十分鐘。

sentences.text: Ivan could do it for two seconds, then three, then five.
sentences.zh: 伊萬可以撐兩秒,然後三秒,然後五秒。

sentences.text: The man beside him, who was perhaps sixty, could not do it at all.
sentences.zh: 他旁邊那位大概六十歲的男士,完全做不到。

sentences.text: Petra stayed with that man for most of the lesson and did not hurry him.
sentences.zh: 佩特拉整堂課大部分時間都陪著那位男士,沒有催他。

sentences.text: By the fourth week, four of the six could float on their backs.
sentences.zh: 到了第四週,六個人裡有四個可以仰躺著漂浮。

sentences.text: By the seventh, Ivan could swim the width of the shallow end without stopping.
sentences.zh: 到了第七週,伊萬可以不停歇地游完淺水區的寬度。

sentences.text: It was not beautiful and his legs sank, but it was swimming.
sentences.zh: 動作不好看,腳一直往下沉,但那確實是在游泳。

sentences.text: He started telling people at work that he was learning, which surprised him.
sentences.zh: 他開始跟公司同事說他在學游泳,這件事連他自己都很意外。

sentences.text: In the ninth week Petra asked the class to move to the deep end.
sentences.zh: 第九週,佩特拉要全班移動到深水區。

sentences.text: Ivan got out of the water instead, and said that his shoulder hurt.
sentences.zh: 伊萬反而爬出了水,說他肩膀痛。

sentences.text: His shoulder did not hurt.
sentences.zh: 他的肩膀根本不痛。

sentences.text: He sat on the edge with his feet in the water and watched the other five.
sentences.zh: 他坐在池邊,腳泡在水裡,看著另外五個人。

sentences.text: The man of sixty, who could not blow bubbles in week one, swam past him.
sentences.zh: 那位第一週連吐氣都做不到、六十歲的男士,從他面前游了過去。

sentences.text: Petra did not call him back in, and she did not ask about the shoulder.
sentences.zh: 佩特拉沒有叫他回水裡,也沒有問肩膀的事。

sentences.text: At the end she sat down beside him with her feet in the water too.
sentences.zh: 課程結束時,她在他旁邊坐下,也把腳泡進水裡。

sentences.text: "The deep end is the same water," she said. "That is not the problem."
sentences.zh: 「深水區是同樣的水,」她說。「問題不在那裡。」

sentences.text: Ivan said nothing, because she was right and he had not known it until then.
sentences.zh: 伊萬沒有說話,因為她說對了,而他到那一刻才知道。

sentences.text: He went home and did not sleep well.
sentences.zh: 他回到家,那晚沒睡好。

sentences.text: He was not afraid of drowning. He had proved that for nine weeks.
sentences.zh: 他不是怕溺水。這件事他已經證明了九個星期。

sentences.text: He was afraid of the moment when the floor stops being there.
sentences.zh: 他怕的是池底不再存在的那一刻。

sentences.text: That was a different fear, and it was much older than the swimming pool.
sentences.zh: 那是另一種恐懼,而且比這座游泳池老得多。

sentences.text: On Tuesday he put his bag in the car an hour before he needed to leave.
sentences.zh: 星期二,他提早一個小時就把包包放進車裡。

sentences.text: He did not know yet whether he was going to get in.
sentences.zh: 他還不知道自己會不會下水。

sentences.text: He only knew that he was going.
sentences.zh: 他只知道自己會去。

questions.q: What did Petra teach in the very first lesson?
options: How to put your face in the water and breathe out
How to float on your back across the pool
How to swim the width of the shallow end

questions.q: Why did Ivan leave the water in the ninth week?
options: He did not want to go to the deep end
His shoulder was genuinely too painful
He had already learned everything in the class

questions.q: What does Ivan understand about his fear that night?
options: It is older than swimming and not about drowning
It will disappear once his shoulder heals
It is caused by being the slowest in the class
